verdict.rationale: Better Auth ships its own OAuth/OIDC flows rather than leaving them to the developer: built-in social OAuth providers (Google, GitHub, Apple, Discord), an SSO plugin supporting OIDC, OAuth2 and SAML, an OAuth authorization-server role via the MCP plugin, and the RFC 8628 device grant. Community users confirm OAuth login and out-of-the-box refresh-token handling, and that it acts as an OIDC provider. missing for 10: explicit documentation of authorization code with PKCE, first-party docs on OAuth refresh-token handling (only community-attested; the session-refresh docs cover app sessions, not OAuth tokens), and in-depth flow-level documentation.
